summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Aurum luxury jewelry e-commerce MVP. Backend APIs and frontend UI are functioning well with minor cart session issues.

flaky_endpoints.issue: Cart session not maintained between requests in API testing
flaky_endpoints.impact: Cart operations fail in backend tests but work in browser

passed_tests: Landing page loads with all sections (Hero, Collections, Products, Craftsmanship, Testimonials, Newsletter, Footer)
Products display correctly from API with 6 bestseller products showing
Add to Cart functionality works with success toast notifications
Newsletter subscription works with success feedback
Admin login works with correct credentials (admin@aurum.com / AurumAdmin123!)
Admin dashboard shows all tabs (Overview, Products, Orders, Inventory, Analytics)
Admin can create new products successfully
Admin can view product inventory and analytics
Backend API endpoints work (23/25 tests passed)
